question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Purview
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"purview"** means the range of experience or thought; the scope of the influence or concerns of something. (सीमा)

 
 
• **Example: **The new law falls within the purview of the federal government.
 
 
 
• **"Domain" **refers to an area of territory owned or controlled by a particular ruler or government; a specified sphere of activity or knowledge. (क्षेत्र)
 
 
• **Example: **Her expertise lies in the domain of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'purview' **is **'domain'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Depth **(गहराई): The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The depth of the ocean is still largely unexplored.
 
 
 
• **Limitation **(सीमा): A restriction or boundary.
 
 
• **Example: **Every system has its limitations, and we need to work within them.
 
 
 
• **Extreme** (चरम): Reaching a high or the highest degree; very great.
 
 
• **Example:** The extreme weather conditions made it difficult to travel.
